$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOQ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Blois - Le Breuil

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

service.atsHours: AFIS : LUN-VEN sauf JF / MON-FRI except public HOL : 0830-1130, 1230-1630 En dehors de ces HOR, PPR AFIS avant 1530 la veille ou le dernier jour ouvré. Outside these SKED, PPR AFIS before 1530 the day before or on the last working day (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Preferred QFU: 300°.
Simultaneous LDG and TKOF prohibited, whatever the runway.
All TKOF or LDG RWY 12/30 is interrupted if an ACFT is occupying the adjacent strip of unpaved RWY 12L/30R.
Possible IFR activity.
TWY A, A2, B, C and N: width 9.50 m.
Special attention Holding points S, Z and U are on a TWY which crosses several runways.
Possible presence of gliders on descent near TWY S, N and C.
Overflight avoidance Avoid overflight of Villefrancoeur, Le Breuil and La Chapelle Vendômoise cities.
Overhead airfield: overhead flying is prohibited during aerobatic activity or parachuting.
Short circuit patterns prohibited during parachuting activities.
Circuit patterns prohibited after 2200 local time except with special authorization from the AD operator.
STAP and PCL: Limited HN with PPR from AFIS before 1530 on the previous day or on the last working day (SUM: - 1 HR).
STAP: Data available (FR only): wind, T°, DP, QNH, QFE, instrumental visibility, cloud cover, miscellaneous.

LUN, MER-VEN / MON, WED-FRI: 0830-1130, 1230-1630 MAR / TUE: 1230-1630 sauf JF / except public HOL Level 2 or 3 outside these SKED, PPR AFIS before 1530 on the previous day or on the last working day.
Level 1 outside these SKED.
Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: Occasionnel - HOR RFFS niveau 3 / Random - RFFS level 3 SKED.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
QFU 300° préférentiel.
Atterrissages et décollages simultanés interdits sur toutes les pistes.
Tout décollage ou atterrissage est suspendu sur la piste 12/30 si un appareil est immobilisé sur la demi-bande accolée de la piste 12L/30R non revêtue.
Activité IFR possible.
TWY A, A2, B, C et N : largeur 9,50 m.
Attention particulière Les points d'attente S, Z et U sont sur un TWY traversant plusieurs pistes.
Présence éventuellle de voiles en descente à proximité des TWY S, N et C.
Evitement de survol Éviter le survol des villes de Villefrancoeur, Le Breuil et La Chapelle Vendômoise.
Verticale terrain : passage verticale terrain interdit pendant activité voltige ou parachutisme.
Circuits courts interdits pendant l'activité parachutisme.
Tour de piste interdit après 2200 locales sauf autorisation exceptionnelle de l'exploitant.
STAP et PCL : Limité HN sur PPR AFIS avant 1530 la veille ou le dernier jour ouvré.
STAP : Paramètres disponibles (FR seulement) : vent, T°, DP, QNH, QFE, visibilité instrumentale, nébulosité, informations diverses éventuelles.
Niveau 2 ou 3 en dehors de ces HOR, PPR AFIS avant 1530 la veille ou le dernier jour ouvré. Niveau 1 en dehors de ces HOR.
